browser.limits: Actual React + production Store via test IPC; Windows paste/clipboard/target receiving and Tauri IPC window plumbing not exercised.

b2Check.source_behavior: The retained B2 CLI accepts --check but always calls Store::check after Store::open. Store::open migrates databases below schema 2; this database was already user_version=2. Store::check validates integrity, foreign keys, and original hashes. This is schema-2 read compatibility evidence, not downgrade or round-trip evidence.

build.status: production build only; runtime acceptance is separate

note: Test groups overlap; do not add counts. Browser uses production React and Store with test IPC, not native Tauri windows. B2 check proves reading this schema-2 synthetic library, not general downgrade or round-trip compatibility.
